title: Build signed reproducible release artifacts for every package set
summary: sign-packages.sh extended with --release-dir mode that discovers and signs every artifact class a public release ships: source tarball (namtor-<ver>.tar.gz), model archive (namtor-models-<ver>.tar.gz + .sha256 sidecar), all Arch split packages (*.pkg.tar.zst — namtor, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde), all Fedora split packages (*.rpm — namtor, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde), all Debian split packages (*.deb — namtor, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde), the SHA256SUMS checksums manifest (generated with --checksums), and the SLSA provenance attestation (namtor.provenance.json). Every discovered artifact receives a per-file detached signature (.minisig for minisign, .asc for GPG); --checksums additionally generates and signs an aggregated SHA256SUMS manifest. verify-reproducible.sh extended with --release-dir: compares every split-package artifact across two independent staging runs and emits per-artifact-kind records (binary, model-archive, source-tarball, arch-package, fedora-package, debian-package, checksums, provenance). Signing uses minisign (Ed25519, preferred) or gpg --detach-sig --armor --digest-algo SHA256 (fallback) — same approach as Task 4. The private signing key is NEVER read by the script (caller's agent/keyring handles it); no key material is committed. The test (45 assertions) covers: (a) sign-packages.sh references all 7 artifact-class patterns + parses --release-dir/--checksums, (b) verify-reproducible.sh parses --release-dir and emits all 8 artifact kinds, (c) a real GPG detached signature verifies on a clean file, (d) tampered file fails verification, (e) wrong-key signature fails verification (and verifies in its own keyring as a sanity check), (f) no private key blocks under packaging/, sign-packages.sh never generates/exports/imports secret keys, throwaway keyring confined to tempdir, public key export contains no private material, (g) --release-dir + --checksums signs all 11 distro artifacts + SHA256SUMS + provenance, SHA256SUMS covers all artifacts, signature verifies, all hashes match on-disk files.

signing_tool.private_key_handling: never read by script — caller's GPG agent or minisign keyring; no key material committed

artifact_coverage.checksums: SHA256SUMS (generated by --checksums; one aggregated signature over the manifest of every artifact's hash)
artifact_coverage.provenance: namtor.provenance.json (SLSA v1.0 in-toto attestation from generate-provenance.py)

sign_modes.default: release binaries + packaging manifests + model archive (development/CI use)
sign_modes.release_dir: --release-dir DIR discovers and signs every artifact class in the release output directory (operator use against dist/)

reproducibility.method: build workspace release twice into two CARGO_TARGET_DIR roots; build model archive twice; with --release-dir, stage the release dir twice and compare every artifact's sha256
reproducibility.determinism_guarantees: Rust [profile.release]: strip=true, lto=true, codegen-units=1, panic=abort; model archive: fixed epoch 0, sorted entries, gzip -n

gates.name: repro-flag
gates.purpose: verify-reproducible.sh parses --release-dir and emits all 8 artifact kinds

gates.name: sign-verify
gates.purpose: GPG detached signature produces .asc and verifies on clean file

gates.name: tamper
gates.purpose: flipping one byte in signed file fails verification

gates.name: wrong-key
gates.purpose: unrelated key's signature fails against first key's keyring; verifies in its own keyring (sanity)

gates.name: no-privkey
gates.purpose: no private key blocks under packaging/; script never generates/exports/imports secrets; keyring confined to tempdir; public export clean

gates.name: release-dir
gates.purpose: --release-dir + --checksums signs 11 distro artifacts + SHA256SUMS + provenance; manifest covers all; signatures verify; hashes match disk

appstream_screenshots.decision: OMITTED — no stable hosting for screenshot URLs exists yet
appstream_screenshots.rationale: AppStream metainfo <screenshot> elements require stable public URLs. The release does not yet have a hosting location for screenshots. Per the task spec, the screenshot metadata elements are omitted rather than pointing at transient/placeholder URLs. They will be added when stable hosting (release-artifacts.namtor.dev or equivalent) is configured.
appstream_screenshots.current_state: metainfo files ship without <screenshots> blocks; AppStream validators accept this (screenshots are recommended, not required)

public_key.fingerprint: PLACEHOLDER — populate on first production release
public_key.note: The release operator generates the signing key out-of-band and publishes the fingerprint in RELEASE_SIGNING.md. No key is committed to the repo. CI secret holds the private key reference for automated release signing.
